# MDL901 · `filename-pattern`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

The file name does not follow the naming convention.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | conventions |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |

## Why

A naming convention keeps each configuration tied to what it dumps. The rule does nothing unless the `conventions` section of the configuration sets it up.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
outputdir=/backups/sales
```

```text
1:1-1:1 error MDL901[filename-pattern] the file name "Sales.cnf" does not match ^(?P<schema>[a-z_]+)-extra-file\.cnf$
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL901: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL901` on the line above it.
